definitions.explanation: The visible shape or outline of a person or thing.
How someone or something looks; outward appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姿|すがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなく→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧{姿|すがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: She looks beautiful in a kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by seeing them work.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧{姿|すがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: He looked different from usual in a suit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧{姿|すがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そっくり→そっくり：00378_sokkuri⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her figure from behind looked just like her mother's.

notes:
{姿|すがた} refers to a person's visible form or appearance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～{姿|すがた} (appearance in..., figure wearing...)
- {姿|すがた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ (one's figure is visible)
- {姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to disappear)
- {姿|すがた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現|あらわ}す→現す：02097_arawasu⟧ (to appear, to show up)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧{姿|すがた} (appearance in kimono)
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧{姿|すがた} (figure from behind)
- ⟦{本来|ほんらい}→本来：09644_honrai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姿|すがた} (true form/nature)
- {姿|すがた}⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (form and shape)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姿|すがた}: figure, appearance (visual form of a person)
- ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧: shape, form (of objects)
- ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧: outward appearance
